method: Retail product/category text inspected through web search and page retrieval; no retail images supplied to generation. Observations separated from design inference.
conclusion: The four proposed showroom groups are commercially understandable. Retail navigation often calls Outerwear Jackets & Coats and Tailoring Suits & Blazers/Suits & Tailoring; Casualwear is a curated umbrella for everyday product families, and Activewear commonly divides by activity. These four groups are not a universal retailer taxonomy.
dateLimits: Search crawl/publication labels are not verified product launch dates. Current availability changes. No proven 2027 trend claim is made. The collection is a 2026/2027 design proposal informed by observed assortment. A COS home open returned summer 2025 despite a 2026 search label and was excluded from current-season evidence. Older Massimo Dutti linen page caches were excluded as current-season proof.

sources.title: H&M — men jackets and coats
sources.retrievalCurrency: Search crawl: today; opened category previously reported a two-month cache.
sources.observed: Assortment includes distinct bomber, trucker, workwear, puffer, windbreaker and long coat families. Men navigation separates denim, shirts, knitwear, matching sets, jackets/coats and suits/blazers.
sources.applicationAndLimit: Breadth and seasonal function only; no price or availability claim.

sources.title: COS — coats and jackets
sources.retrievalCurrency: Search crawl: today; relaxed-fit category five days ago.
sources.observed: Separate coat, wool, leather/suede and overshirt filters; actual items include wool long coats, nylon bombers, Harringtons, denim and utility layers.
sources.applicationAndLimit: Supports material and length differentiation, not one repeated generic jacket.

sources.title: COS — suits and tailoring

sources.observed: Wool, linen, unstructured and collarless jackets appear with straight, wide and pleated trousers.
sources.applicationAndLimit: Category breadth, no statement that all suit cuts are a 2027 trend.

sources.title: ASOS — sportswear assortment
